title: The Last Lighthouse Keeper
caption:
He kept the light burning for 40 years. One night, someone answered. 🌊✨

#aistory #shortstory #runwayml #storytelling
style: cinematic, moody blue-hour lighting, 35mm film grain, consistent old man with white beard and yellow raincoat
scenes: Wide aerial shot of a lonely lighthouse on a rocky cliff at dusk, huge waves crashing below, the lamp flickers on
Close-up of an old lighthouse keeper's weathered hands winding the brass lamp mechanism, he whispers 'one more night'
Through the rain-streaked lighthouse window, a tiny boat light blinks back three times far out at sea
The keeper smiles with tears in his eyes as the beam sweeps across the dark ocean toward the small boat
